capacity.text: Compute capacity is now 40x the starting plan: two accounts at 20x usage each.

ceiling.label: MODELLED
ceiling.method: capacity multiple x cost-per-job multiple (they stack; parallelism overlaps capacity)
ceiling.text: 40x the capacity times 8.4x cheaper jobs is a ceiling of up to 336x the work for the same share of budget.

cost_job.label: MEASURED
cost_job.method: 25 matched jobs, before and after the compressed kernel
cost_job.text: Cost per AI job fell 8.4x, from US$0.97 to US$0.12, while quality rose from 23 of 25 to 25 of 25.

estate.label: MEASURED

estate_cost.label: MODELLED

estate_ey.label: MODELLED

fleet_share.label: MEASURED

needle.label: MODELLED
